coord_source_text: village of Soumousso (N 11°00, W 04°03) located in the Sudan Savannah zone, 380 km from Ouagadougou and 38 km from Bobo-Dioulasso
source_text: All mosquitoes used in this study were collected during the rainy season of 2008 in the village of Soumousso (N 11°00, W 04°03) located in the Sudan Savannah zone... Mosquitoes were collected as larvae and reared to adults for morphological classification of species and sex. Only the female An. gambiae complex mosquitoes were used for analysis.
